chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
O you who believe, the witness between you when death approaches one of you, at the time of bequest, shall be two just men from among you, or two others from outside of you.
He said: “They are two disbelievers.” I said: “Two just men from among you?” He said: “Two Muslims.”

key_terms.آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ: two others from outside your community
key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death, when a person nears the end of life
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: bequest or testament made before death
key_terms.ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ: two just witnesses from among the Muslims
key_terms.شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ: testimony given among you in a legal matter

ai.seo_question: Who are the witnesses meant by “two just men from among you, or two others from outside of you” in Qur'an 5:106?
ai.summary: This hadith explains part of Qur'an 5:106 concerning witnesses to a bequest when death is near. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام interprets “two others from outside of you” as two disbelievers, and “two just men from among you” as two Muslims, clarifying the categories of witnesses mentioned in the verse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5434 - Muhammad ibn Al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abu Al-Ṣabah Al-Kinani, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:

"O' you who believe! Witnesses between you when death approaches one of you, at the time of bequest, are two just men from among you, or two others from outside of you."
(Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:106)

Imam (as) said: "They are two disbelievers."
I asked: "Two just men from among you?"
Imam (as) said: "They are two Muslims."
